# Aditya Rajbhar

> Aditya Rajbhar (handle: codebyaadi) is a software engineer from India. He
> builds full-stack web applications and backend systems across the TypeScript,
> Go and Python stacks. This is his personal site and portfolio.

Since September 2026 Aditya has been a Full Stack Developer at BrainFog
Technologies (Next.js, Prisma, Python, Android, MCP, LangChain, LangGraph). From
2024 to 2026 he was a Software Developer at Landmark Aquatec, building the web
platform for water- and sewage-treatment products: real-time IoT dashboards
over live plant telemetry, backed by FastAPI services on Google Cloud with
Firestore and a React / Next.js front end. He is open to new roles and projects.

## Focus areas

- Full-stack web development — React, Next.js, SvelteKit, Node.js, ElysiaJS, NestJS
- Backend and distributed systems — Go, Rust, PostgreSQL, Redis, job queues
- AI agents and tooling — MCP, LangGraph, retrieval, tool use, voice pipelines
- Cloud and infrastructure — Google Cloud, AWS, Docker, Turborepo, Bun

## Selected projects

- [Upzy](https://upzy.codebyaadi.com): Uptime monitoring and external attack-surface security for small teams.
  Bun + Turborepo, ElysiaJS API, Next.js, PostgreSQL with Drizzle, Better Auth.
  Open-source edition: https://github.com/codebyaadi/upzy-oss
- [Lookfar](https://lookfar.codebyaadi.com): Self-hosted watcher agents that
  check pages, feeds and repos and ask before acting. Go, SvelteKit,
  PostgreSQL with pgvector. Source: https://github.com/codebyaadi/lookfar
- [Avni](https://avni.codebyaadi.com): Speech-first personal assistant. Kotlin Android app and a Rust core
  with tiered model routing and MCP tools. Private repository.
- [Keel](https://github.com/codebyaadi/keel): SaaS starter kit. Bun +
  Turborepo, ElysiaJS, Next.js, Prisma 8, Better Auth, React Email.
- [Vitube](https://vitube-streaming-platform.vercel.app/): Video streaming
  platform on the MERN stack with Cloudinary.
